### Bible Pathway - May 15
Author: Bible Pathway
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-may-15-2013.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 11:18
Points:
- Three of David’s mighty men showed great courage by breaking through enemy lines to bring him water.
- David poured the water out before the Lord instead of drinking it himself.
- David was not being ungrateful; he was honoring the life-threatening sacrifice made by his men.
- Christians should recognize and support those who make selfless sacrifices for God’s kingdom.
- Intercessory prayer and volunteering time are powerful ways believers can encourage and assist others in ministry.
